description_en: This operation associates a MacSec key with a port on a dedicated physical connection. It uses dedicated encryption hardware, such as a NIC or switch, to perform low-latency encryption and decryption. It directly encrypts the physical link, such as a fiber optic or Ethernet cable, to protect all traffic from the sender to the receiver
description_zh: 支持在独享物理专线端口上面关联MacSec密钥，通过专用加密芯片（如 NIC 或交换机）实现低延迟加密/解密，从而直接对物理链路（如光纤、以太网）进行加密，覆盖从发送方到接收方的全部流量
kebab_example: aliyun vpc associate-mac-sec-key --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --physical-connection-id pc-bp1hp0wr072f60000 --cipher-suite GCM-AES-128 --ckn 0123456789ABCDEF0123456789ABCDEF --cak 0123456789ABCDEF0123456789ABCDEF --region cn-hangzhou
name: AssociateMacSecKey

parameters.description_en: The key name. This parameter accepts only hexadecimal characters. Lowercase letters are automatically converted to uppercase. The cipher suite determines the required length of the key name: 32 hexadecimal characters for GCM-AES-128 or GCM-AES-XPN-128, and 64 hexadecimal characters for GCM-AES-256 or GCM-AES-XPN-256.
parameters.description_zh: 密钥名称，只支持十六进制字符，小写会自动转换为大写，当加密算法类型是GCM-AES-128或者GCM-AES-XPN-128时，长度要求为32个十六进制字符，当加密算法类型是GCM-AES-256或者GCM-AES-XPN-256时，长度要求为64个十六进制字符
